Message:
Bluetooth: Keep msec in DISCOV_LE_TIMEOUT

To be consistent, lets use msec for this timeout as well.

Note: This define value is a minimum scan time taken from BT Core spec 4.0,
Vol 3, Part C, chapter 9.2.6
